source_excerpts.text: • Big Data are “data sets that are so big they cannot be handled efficiently by common database management systems” (Dasgupta, 2013). 13 • Geospatial/spatial Big Data (or, Big Geo-Data) refer to spatial data sets exceeding capacity of current computing systems. – There is no standard threshold on minimum size of Big Data or spatial Big Data, although big data in 2013 was considered one PBs/petabyte (1,000 TBs/terabytes) or larger (Dasgupta, 2013).
source_excerpts.reason: Representative excerpt selected from the spatial-analysis knowledge base.

source_excerpts.text: Where are these Big Data coming from? They are sensor data produced by… • Satellite remote sensing • Aerial (manned or unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV)) surveying • Radar/Lidar Scanning • Sensor networks • Digital cameras • Location of readings of RFID (射频识别) • Mobile devices • Internet of things • Models, such as WRF, PLUS,CASE… • GNSS (Global Navigation Satellite System) • including BeiDou, GPS, Galileo … • GNSS-enabled devices • …… (Partially based on Dasgupta, 2013) 19

source_excerpts.text: • Big Data are “data sets that are so big they cannot be handled efficiently by common database management systems” (Dasgupta, 2013). 13 • Geospatial/spatial Big Data (or, Big Geo-Data) refer to spatial data sets exceeding capacity of current computing systems. – There is no standard threshold on minimum size of Big Data or spatial Big Data, although big data in 2013 was considered one PBs/petabyte (1,000 TBs/terabytes) or larger (Dasgupta, 2013).
source_excerpts.reason: Representative excerpt selected from the spatial-analysis knowledge base.

source_excerpts.text: Where are these Big Data coming from? They are sensor data produced by… • Satellite remote sensing • Aerial (manned or unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV)) surveying • Radar/Lidar Scanning • Sensor networks • Digital cameras • Location of readings of RFID (射频识别) • Mobile devices • Internet of things • Models, such as WRF, PLUS,CASE… • GNSS (Global Navigation Satellite System) • including BeiDou, GPS, Galileo … • GNSS-enabled devices • …… (Partially based on Dasgupta, 2013) 19

sections.teaching_script:
本节围绕“地理空间大数据分析：geospatial big data / GIS”组织教学。先让学生识别核心概念和问题背景，再结合来源页码中的定义、方法或案例说明其分析逻辑。讲解时要强调适用条件、输入数据、分析结果解释，以及它与前后知识点的联系。

材料依据：Find Locations—Find Similar Locations查找相似位置 Identifies the candidate features that are most similar or dissimilar to one or more input features based on feature attributes. • Tabular, point, line, or area features can be used. • An input search (candidate) layer is required.
